aiResearchSummary.text: Security risk remediation tool focuses on protecting web applications by generating scan results through a server web browser that follows a behavior pattern simulating real user access to a web service. By executing this scan and observing how the web service responds, it identifies and supports remediation of security risks in client side interactions. Overall, Feroot Security is researching and developing automated web service scanning and security risk remediation.
